title: Introduction to Computer Vision in PyTorch knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Image tensors and channel layouts” in this lesson?

This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.

Check image dimensions, channel order, value range, and label/target formats; reuse compatible transforms for validation and inference.

questions.explanation: Image tensors and channel layouts: Check image dimensions, channel order, value range, and label/target formats; reuse compatible transforms for validation and inference.

Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
confirm image layout, numeric range, normalization, label format, and that validation/inference do not use random training-only augmentation.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “TorchVision datasets, models, and transforms”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not normalize or resize inference images differently from the preprocessing used during training.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not normalize or resize inference images differently from the preprocessing used during training.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not normalize or resize inference images differently from the preprocessing used during training.
